third-party software list, tools-used list, contract schedule, or other
Customer-accessible project document.

not delivered to the Customer, an unrelated general website, or a location
not reasonably accessible to the Customer's technical team is insufficient.
The Customer name and engagement name need not be made public. A private
Customer-facing document is sufficient. No Customer confidential information
must be sent to the Licensor.
rules.scope_note: Section 7 states that internal-only registers, undelivered package metadata, unrelated websites, and locations not reasonably accessible to the Customer's technical team are insufficient. Customer and engagement names need not be public; a private Customer-facing document suffices. No Customer confidential information must be sent to the Licensor.
rules.condition_explanation: The duty to provide a notice remains subject to the accessibility requirement in Section 7. This paragraph identifies insufficient placements and clarifies that public disclosure of Customer or engagement names, and sending Customer confidential information to the Licensor, are not required.
